Motivation for the distant-rotation extension: any rotation, local or distant, that stays feasible has exactly the same reconstruction loss as the original fit (per §1's exact identity) — unlike a different-seed/different-basin disagreement (§1's Run 2 vs Run 4: recon_loss 0.7593 vs 0.7591, opposite anchor-coherence structure), which loss can distinguish. A distant feasible rotation would be invisible to loss-based selection by construction.

A community's domain-skew identity is not reproducible across independently-trained seeds — confirmed with the pipeline's own §S5 alignment, not just a weaker proxy. Distinct from §18 (this is problem 1a, relabeling across independently-trained fits, not 1b, local rotation freedom within one fit) — the two should not be conflated.

Question: does a community's apparent domain character survive across independent re-fits of the same (config,K), or does it reshuffle? Answering requires aligning communities across seeds first — community index is only meaningful within one fit (§14).

This sharpens the concern about interpreting domain-skew labels as substantive across anything other than one specific reported fit, consistent with the caveat throughout this document that cross-fit/cross-seed comparisons require relabeling correction (§14/§16/§17). Toy-corpus-calibrated — re-derive at 22k-article scale; a denser corpus could change this either way.

The concern precisely: collapse_pen is the only quantity that is (a) derived from Z_scaled and (b) read by Optuna every trial, feeding sociological_penalty (§4.17/§4.20; ticket 81). Worry: Z_scaled can be reshaped by the optimizer without genuine reconstruction change (the same scale-invariance slack §4.2 already closed once for z_offdiag_loss), showing up as a collapse_pen improvement not corresponding to real de-concentration of entities.

This is directly consistent with the mechanism §2 already confirmed once for z_offdiag_loss: raising lambda_z_offdiag can move Z_scaled's readout toward 'looks balanced' via the community-resizing route rather than genuine de-concentration.

Follow-up question: does Z_scaled's full diagonal/off-diagonal pattern (not just collapse_pen's one scalar) track independent structure? Answer: yes, moderately, and the decline under lambda_z_offdiag pressure is confirmed real, not noise. collapse_pen reads only max_share; this says nothing about whether the raw diagonal/off-diagonal values §1 and this document's community-coupling interpretation depend on can be reshaped by the same training-dynamics-driven slack.
